query: Help me understand what's in these airline reviews — I'm not sure which aspect is most worth analyzing.

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Well-differentiated categorical axis for a key review aspect; values track the crew descriptions in the samples well and correctly uses Unknown when silent.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_and_space
per_column.rationale: Useful thematic axis but partly redundant with the original 'Seat Comfort' rating column; values are well grounded (cramped, spacious, adequate all match the text).

per_column.name: food_beverage_quality
per_column.rationale: Meaningful but overlaps with original 'Food & Beverages' rating; text-grounded, with correct Unknown for silent rows.

per_column.name: aircraft_condition_recency
per_column.rationale: New axis not in originals, but tends to assert 'well_maintained_adequate' even when the text is silent (e.g. amazing-flight row had no aircraft-condition statement), and NULL rate is lower than warranted, indicating over-confident inference.

per_column.name: operational_disruption
per_column.rationale: Delay/cancellation axis is analytically valuable, but 'on_time_reliable' is asserted for rows that never mention timing (the dreadful-seats review, the food review), inferring reliability from silence.

per_column.name: service_consistency_trend
per_column.rationale: A 'trend over time' claim requires longitudinal signal a single review rarely provides; near-zero NULL rate shows it is fabricated from sentiment (e.g. 'reliably_average' assigned to a purely negative seat review).

per_column.name: amenity_availability
per_column.rationale: Potentially useful but has ZERO NULLs, so every row is forced into a service-level bucket even when amenities are never discussed (the dreadful-seats row labeled 'minimal_service_cuts' with no basis).

per_column.name: price_value_alignment
per_column.rationale: Overlaps original 'Value For Money'; values are frequently invented where price is unmentioned (labeled 'fair_price_acceptable'/'premium_justified' on reviews with no price content).

per_column.name: ground_operations_quality
per_column.rationale: Check-in/ground axis is genuinely new, but 'smooth_efficient_helpful' is asserted for reviews discussing only inflight experience, low NULL rate signals inference from silence.

per_column.name: aircraft_age_and_condition
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of 'aircraft_condition_recency' with nearly identical value distribution; adds no new analytical leverage and shares the same over-inference issue.

per_column.name: ground_and_checkin_experience
per_column.rationale: Restatement of 'ground_operations_quality' with the same value vocabulary; redundant. Higher NULL rate makes it slightly better grounded but still duplicative.

per_column.name: operational_disruption_and_reliability
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of 'operational_disruption'; same inference-from-silence problem, adds no distinct axis.

per_column.name: service_consistency_and_trend
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of 'service_consistency_trend'; same fabricated longitudinal claim with near-zero NULLs.

per_column.name: value_for_money_perception
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of 'price_value_alignment'; redundant restatement with the same over-assertion of price sentiment.

judge.rationale: Several columns provide genuine new aspect axes (crew, ground ops, disruption) suited to the exploratory query, but the set is heavily degraded by near-exact duplicate pairs (aircraft_condition vs aircraft_age, ground_operations vs ground_and_checkin, operational_disruption vs ..._and_reliability, service_consistency_trend vs ..._and_trend, price_value_alignment vs value_for_money_perception), which add no new leverage and drag table-level usefulness down. Groundedness is mixed: aspect columns that use Unknown for silent rows are sound, but multiple columns (operational_disruption, service_consistency_trend, amenity_availability, price/value) infer confident specifics from silence with implausibly low NULL rates, a recurrent hallucination pattern.
